clips.title: The story
paras: In Dolanaar, Syral Bladeleaf sends a late shipment of rare earth south to Denalan at Lake Al'Ameth. The night elf researcher studies Teldrassil's young plants.

Syral Bladeleaf stops travelers in Dolanaar with a special shipment of rare earth for Denalan. The soil came from Darnassus to support his botanical studies, but delays kept it from reaching Dolanaar until now. Syral seeks a courier to carry the parcel south along the forest trail to Denalan's campsite by Lake Al'Ameth.

Denalan works alone at a station on Lake Al'Ameth's eastern shore, watching Teldrassil's young ecosystem take root. The tree grew quickly after the Battle of Mount Hyjal, and its plants behave in unexpected ways. Denalan tests the vitality and behavior of timberlings and native plants with unique soil mixtures and specimens. The rare earth shipment will support those experiments.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: Are you heading to the south? To Lake Al'Ameth? If so, then I have a task I might ask of you...

My colleague Denalan has a camp along the eastern end of the lake, where he is studying and experimenting on the plant life of Teldrassil. He requested a package of rare earths from Darnassus and it was late, only recently arriving here in Dolanaar.
Can you take the package to him?

clips.title: Completion
paras: Ah, it's here! I have waited for this rare earth for quite some time. I hope it's still fresh...
Thank you for bringing it to me, friend. You are a night elf who is generous with their time.
